# D15, R2-06 (mutHeartbeatUnclamped): a heartbeat carries the commit clamped
# to what the follower is known to hold, never the leader's whole commit.
add-nodes 1 voters=1,2,3 term=1 commit=2 log=1,1
----
ok

campaign 1 elect
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  seq=1
  HardState term=2 vote=1 commit=2
  AfterSync:
    1->2 MsgVote term=2 logterm=1 index=2
    1->3 MsgVote term=2 logterm=1 index=2
  Apply:
    1/1 command "e1-t1"
    2/1 command "e2-t1"
  Membership 1@0 2@0 3@0

storage-done 1
----
> 1 storage done seq=1 through 0/0

step 1 type=MsgVoteResp from=2 term=2
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  seq=2
  Entries:
    3/2 noop
  Messages:
    1->2 MsgApp term=2 logterm=1 index=2 commit=2 [3/2 noop]
    1->3 MsgApp term=2 logterm=1 index=2 commit=2 [3/2 noop]

storage-done 1
----
> 1 storage done seq=2 through 3/2

# Neither peer acknowledged anything: both heartbeats carry commit 0.
tick 1
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  Messages:
    1->2 MsgHeartbeat term=2 hint=3 ctx=1
    1->3 MsgHeartbeat term=2 hint=3 ctx=1

step 1 type=MsgAppResp from=2 term=2 index=3
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  seq=3
  Commit 3
  Messages:
    1->2 MsgApp term=2 logterm=2 index=3 commit=3
  Apply:
    3/2 noop

# Peer 2 holds the whole log, peer 3 nothing yet.
tick 1
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  Messages:
    1->2 MsgHeartbeat term=2 commit=3 hint=3 ctx=2
    1->3 MsgHeartbeat term=2 hint=3 ctx=2
